title: Lusin's theorem on ℝⁿ for vector-valued maps on sets of infinite measure
statement: For all n, m ∈ ℕ, every Borel set S ⊆ ℝⁿ (of possibly infinite Lebesgue measure), every Borel map ν : ℝⁿ → ℝᵐ and every real ε > 0, there is a closed set C ⊆ S such that ν restricted to C is continuous and Lⁿ(S∖C) < ε. Here ℝⁿ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) and Lⁿ = volume.
lean_statement: ∀ (n m : ℕ) (S : Set (Rn n)) (ν : Rn n → Rn m), MeasurableSet S → Measurable ν → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ C ⊆ S, IsClosed C ∧ ContinuousOn ν C ∧ volume (S \ C) < ENNReal.ofReal ε
